en: Black‑and‑white image of a modernist fountain featuring two nude, elongated bronze figures—likely a man and a woman—posed dynamically as though gliding or swimming while grasping each other's hands. Water jets spray upward around them in a shallow circular basin. In the background are a paved path, grass, shrubs, and some trees, suggesting a city park setting. No printed title or caption is visible on the image side.
